message.text: There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is defined in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` files. These are served via Connect RPC and gRPC-Gateway REST. MCP and OpenAPI are generated from those proto definitions.

r05.
There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is Protocol Buffers under `proto/api/v1/`, served as Connect RPC and gRPC-Gateway REST (`server/router/api/v1/`), with generated OpenAPI in `proto/gen/`.
